source.title: Alexander Lau wins Rubik's Cube European Championships 2014
source.content:
[Alexander Lau](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2011LAUA01) won the [Rubik's Cube European Championships 2014](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2014) with an average of 8.02 seconds. [Philipp Weyer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010WEYE01) finished second (8.26) and [Sebastian Weyer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010WEYE02) finished third (8.38).  
 World records: Louis Cormier Megaminx 39.57 (single), Megaminx 45.77 (average), Sebastian Weyer 4x4 Cube 21.97 (single), 4x4 Cube 27.17 (average).  
 African records: Conor Cronin 3x3 blindfolded 1:46.67 (single), 3x3 fewest moves 43.00 (average), Megaminx 1:52.93 (single), Megaminx 2:05.49 (average), Rubik's Clock 7.17 (single), Skewb 7.64 (single), Skewb 11.73 (average), 6x6 Cube 3:42.39 (average), 7x7 Cube 5:21.99 (average).  
 European records: Mattia Furlan 6x6 Cube 2:03.87 (average), Michał Halczuk 6x6 Cube 2:03.07 (average), Przemysław Kaleta 3x3 one-handed 9.41 (single).

translation.title: Alexander Lau 获得 2014 年欧洲魔方锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Alexander Lau](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2011LAUA01) 以 8.02 秒的平均成绩获得 [2014 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2014)冠军。[Philipp Weyer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010WEYE01) 以 8.26 秒获得亚军，[Sebastian Weyer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010WEYE02) 以 8.38 秒获得季军。

世界纪录：Louis Cormier，五魔方单次 39.57 秒、平均 45.77 秒；Sebastian Weyer，四阶单次 21.97 秒、平均 27.17 秒。

非洲纪录：Conor Cronin，三阶盲拧单次 1:46.67、三阶最少步平均 43.00 步、五魔方单次 1:52.93、平均 2:05.49、魔表单次 7.17 秒、斜转单次 7.64 秒、平均 11.73 秒、六阶平均 3:42.39、七阶平均 5:21.99。

欧洲纪录：Mattia Furlan，六阶平均 2:03.87；Michał Halczuk，六阶平均 2:03.07；Przemysław Kaleta，三阶单手单次 9.41 秒。
